items: MultiCut finds many more drops and song changes on its own, and places your track files reliably.
Cuts vary more: no fixed camera rotation, phrase-length shots, builds that speed up, and a Re-roll that always gives something new.
New cut styles: punch-ins, a hero camera on each drop, strobe into drops, and Shuffle with three choices to pick from.
Zooms move at a steady speed, follow the music, and can aim at the DJ, pan wide shots, snap, pulse, flash or whip into a drop.
The crowd sound is now one clean file that stays in time with the mix, with the PA taken out and a level that rides the music.
Loudness target for YouTube with a one-click fix when the mix would clip; the best room mic is picked for you.
Render vertical clips straight to MP4, export to Resolve or Final Cut, and get tracklist, subtitle and marker files with every export.
Import DJ history from rekordbox, Serato, Traktor or a CUE sheet, or let MultiCut find your tracks in your music folder.
Cameras sync while their previews are still being made, and previews are much faster.
Projects can be opened from a folder, located when moved, or removed from the list.
Settings sit in full-height panels, playback is smoother, and MultiCut asks before quitting while it is working.
